jobs.title: Director of FP&A
jobs.description:
Wonka Industries makes chocolate bars, seasonal candy and baking ingredients sold in grocery, club and convenience stores across North America. We run three factories, a test kitchen and a distribution center, and we are a 2,400-person, family-owned consumer products company with $1.3 billion in annual revenue.

We are hiring a Director of FP&A to lead planning for the whole company. You will report to the Chief Financial Officer, lead a team of seven analysts and managers, and own the numbers our leadership team and board run the business on.

What you will own:
- The annual operating plan, from top-down targets through the bottom-up build with every business unit.
- The monthly rolling forecast and the three-year long-range plan.
- The board reporting package and the monthly executive review: results, variance commentary and the outlook.
- Pricing, promotion and capital investment analysis with the commercial and supply chain teams.
- The planning model and the move from spreadsheets to a planning tool next year.
- Hiring, coaching and growing the FP&A team.

About you:
- 10+ years in FP&A or corporate finance, with at least three leading a team.
- Experience in consumer products, food or another manufacturing business with a cost-of-goods story to tell.
- You can explain a variance to a plant manager and to the board in the same afternoon.
- CPA, CFA or MBA preferred.

How we work: decisions are made in the open, the numbers are shared widely, and we promote from within. Every employee gets a share of the profit-sharing pool.

This role is hybrid, three days a week at our Chicago headquarters in the West Loop. The base salary range is $175,000 to $195,000, plus an annual bonus.

Wonka Industries is an equal opportunity employer.
jobs.rationale:
$1.3B, family-owned, chocolate and candy CPG, grocery/club/convenience. Top FP&A seat, reports to CFO. Owns annual plan, rolling forecast, LRP, board reporting, team of seven, planning-tool migration. Culture: Transparent decisions, profit-sharing, promotes from within.
Criteria: owns plan +3, cfo line +1, team +1, board reporting +1. Comp tops out at $195K, $190K+: +1. Hybrid near Chicago, IL: +1.

jobs.title: Director of FP&A (direct hire for Aperture Science)
jobs.description:
Hooli Talent Partners is recruiting a Director of FP&A on behalf of our client, Aperture Science, a privately held research company that develops portable energy and materials technologies for industrial and government customers. Aperture Science employs about 1,100 people across two research campuses. This is a direct-hire role; you will be an Aperture Science employee.

The Director of FP&A reports to Aperture Science's Chief Financial Officer and leads a team of five.

Responsibilities:
- Own the annual plan and the quarterly forecast for the company's research programs and its commercial business.
- Build the long-range plan and the funding model behind each research program.
- Work with program managers on staffing plans and spend.
- Track program budgets against milestones with research leaders, and explain the variances.
- Support the pricing of government contracts and commercial agreements.
- Lead and develop the FP&A team.

Qualifications:
- 10+ years in FP&A, including leadership of a team.
- Experience at a research-driven company, in defense, energy or life sciences, or with government contracts.
- Strong modeling and communication skills.

Our client values rigor, curiosity and plain talk about results.

The role is remote within the United States, with quarterly visits to Aperture Science's research campus. The base salary range is $155,000 to $180,000, plus an annual bonus.

Hooli Talent Partners and Aperture Science are equal opportunity employers.
jobs.rationale:
~1,100-person private research firm, energy/materials tech, industrial and government. Top FP&A seat, reports to CFO. Owns annual plan, quarterly forecast, long-range plan, program budgets, team of five. Culture: Rigor, curiosity, plain talk about results.
Criteria: owns plan +3, cfo line +1, team +1, board reporting +1.

jobs.title: Director of Financial Planning
jobs.description:
Wayne Enterprises is a family-controlled holding company. Its businesses span commercial real estate, property management and professional services. The group employs about 6,000 people, and its Chicago office runs finance for the holding company and three of its operating businesses.

We are hiring a Director of Financial Planning to lead planning for the Chicago group. You will report to the Vice President of Corporate Development and lead a team of five analysts.

Responsibilities:
- Own the annual plan and the quarterly forecast for the holding company and its Chicago businesses.
- Build the long-range plan and the capital allocation analysis behind our investment decisions.
- Build the deal and portfolio models the corporate development team works from.
- Work with each operating business's finance lead on targets, results and variance explanations.
- Support the treasury team on cash and debt planning.
- Lead and develop the planning team.

Qualifications:
- 10+ years in FP&A, corporate finance or investment analysis, including team leadership.
- Experience with a multi-business or holding company structure.
- Clear writing and the judgment to know which number matters.
- MBA or CFA preferred.

The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Chicago office on Wacker Drive. Compensation is competitive and includes an annual bonus.

Wayne Enterprises is an equal opportunity employer.
jobs.rationale:
~6,000-person family-controlled holding company; real estate, property management, professional services. Likely the top FP&A seat for the Chicago group. Owns annual plan, quarterly forecast, long-range plan, capital allocation, deal modeling; leads team of five. Culture: no signal in posting.
Criteria: owns plan +3, cfo line +1, team +1. Hybrid near Chicago, IL: +1.

jobs.title: Head of FP&A
jobs.description:
Pym Technologies develops advanced materials: lightweight alloys, specialty coatings and the processes that make them at scale. Our materials are used by aircraft, medical device and electronics manufacturers. We are a 1,500-person company with a research campus and two production sites, and our revenue has doubled in four years.

We are hiring a Head of FP&A to build planning for a company moving from research-led to production-led growth. You will report to the Chief Financial Officer and lead a team of five.

What you will own:
- The annual operating plan and the rolling forecast, from the research portfolio to the factory floor.
- The long-range plan and the capital investment cases for new production capacity.
- Spending plans and cost targets with each research and production leader.
- Product-line profitability and the cost models behind our pricing.
- Building and leading the FP&A team as the company grows.

About you:
- 10+ years in FP&A, with experience leading a team at a manufacturing or technology company.
- Experience planning for a business with long research cycles and heavy capital spending.
- You build models others can read and explain them simply.

How we work: we fund curiosity, we share our results openly inside the company, and we are building for the long term.

The role is hybrid, three days a week at our Seattle campus, and we offer relocation support. The base salary range is $170,000 to $200,000, plus bonus and equity.

Pym Technologies is an equal opportunity employer.
jobs.rationale:
1,500-person advanced materials R&D and production, aerospace/med/electronics clients. Top FP&A seat, reports to CFO. Owns annual plan, rolling forecast, long-range plan, capex cases, product-line P&L, team of five. Culture: Funds curiosity, open internally, long-term builders.
Criteria: owns plan +3, cfo line +1, team +1, board reporting +1. Comp tops out at $200K, $190K+: +1. Relo: would-relocate (Seattle, WA, 0 mi): -2.

jobs.title: Director of Financial Planning and Analysis
jobs.description:
Pied Piper builds data storage software that companies use to keep large files fast to reach and cheap to store. More than 900 customers run on our platform, including the hospitals that keep patients' imaging records on it and the public libraries that archive their collections with us. We are a 450-person software company with recurring revenue of $140 million, growing about 30 percent a year.

We are looking for a Director of Financial Planning and Analysis to lead planning as we prepare for our next stage of growth. You will report to the Chief Financial Officer and lead a team of four.

Responsibilities:
- Own the annual operating plan and the quarterly reforecast, working with every department head.
- Build and run the long-range plan and the model behind our fundraising and investor updates.
- Track bookings, recurring revenue, retention and unit economics, and explain what moves them.
- Partner with sales, engineering and customer success on headcount, hiring plans and spend.
- Prepare the monthly management package for the executive team.
- Lead, coach and grow a team of four analysts.

Qualifications:
- 8+ years in FP&A, including several at a subscription software company.
- Experience owning a plan and a forecast end to end and leading a team.
- Strong modeling skills and comfort presenting to executives.
- Experience with a planning tool and a modern data stack is a plus.

Our culture: we write things down, we share context widely, and we give people room to own their work. We publish our salary bands internally.

The role is fully remote within the United States, with a team gathering twice a year. The base salary range is $160,000 to $185,000, plus equity.

Pied Piper is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from every background.
jobs.rationale:
450-person, $140M ARR, data storage software for hospitals and libraries. Top FP&A seat, reports to CFO. Owns annual plan, rolling reforecast, long-range plan, investor model, executive reporting, team of four. Culture: writes things down, wide context-sharing, ownership, transparent pay bands.
Criteria: owns plan +3, cfo line +1, team +1, board reporting +1.

jobs.title: Director of FP&A
jobs.description:
Vandelay Industries imports and distributes industrial packaging and specialty plastics to manufacturers across North America. We run twelve distribution centers and employ about 1,800 people, with revenue of $900 million.

We are hiring a Director of FP&A to lead planning across our regional businesses. You will report to the Chief Financial Officer and lead a team of four analysts.

Responsibilities:
- Own the annual plan and the monthly forecast for the company and each region.
- Build the long-range plan and the business cases behind new distribution centers.
- Prepare the monthly results package for the executive team.
- Work in person with each regional general manager on their plan, their results and their cost structure.
- Lead and develop the FP&A team.

Travel: this role travels 30 to 40 percent of the time. You will spend at least one week a month at our distribution centers and regional offices, and more during planning season.

Qualifications:
- 8+ years in FP&A, including team leadership.
- Experience in distribution, logistics or manufacturing.
- Strong modeling skills and comfort working with operators on the floor.
- Willingness to travel as described above.

The role is hybrid, based at our Chicago headquarters when you are not traveling. The base salary range is $150,000 to $170,000, plus an annual bonus.

Vandelay Industries is an equal opportunity employer.
jobs.rationale:
~1,800-person, industrial packaging and specialty plastics distributor, North America. Top FP&A seat, reports to CFO. Owns annual plan, monthly forecast, long-range plan, exec reporting, team of four. Culture: no signal in posting.
Criteria: owns plan +3, cfo line +1, team +1, travel -2. Hybrid near Chicago, IL: +1.

jobs.title: Director of FP&A
jobs.description:
Dunder Mifflin is a regional paper and office supplies distributor serving small and mid-size businesses across the Northeast and Midwest. We run eleven branches with about 900 employees and annual revenue of $310 million.

We are hiring a Director of FP&A to lead planning for the company. You will report to the Chief Financial Officer and manage two analysts: the team is two people today, with no plans to grow it.

Responsibilities:
- Own the annual budget and the quarterly forecast for the company and each branch.
- Build branch profitability reporting and explain what drives each branch's results.
- Maintain the monthly branch scorecards the branch managers use.
- Support pricing analysis and customer profitability work with the sales team.
- Work with the controller on the monthly close and the variance commentary.
- Coach and develop the two analysts.

Qualifications:
- 7+ years in FP&A or corporate finance.
- Experience in distribution or another branch-based business.
- Advanced spreadsheet modeling skills and clear writing.
- Experience managing at least one analyst.

Our culture: our branches are close-knit, our customers stay with us for decades, and we value people who show up for each other.

This role is fully remote within the United States, with occasional visits to branches. The base salary range is $95,000 to $110,000, plus an annual bonus.

Dunder Mifflin is an equal opportunity employer.
jobs.rationale:
~900-person regional paper and office-supplies distributor, 11 branches. Top FP&A seat, reports to CFO. Owns annual budget, quarterly forecast, branch profitability, scorecards; manages two analysts. Culture: Close-knit branches, long-tenured customers, mutual support.
Criteria: owns plan +3, cfo line +1, board reporting +1. Comp tops out at $110K, below $140K: -2.

jobs.title: Director of Finance Systems
jobs.description:
Stark Industries designs and manufactures industrial equipment, power systems and precision components for customers in energy, transportation and construction. We are an 11,000-person company with operations in nine countries.

We are hiring a Director of Finance Systems to lead the technology behind our finance organization. You will report to the Vice President of Finance Transformation and lead a team of six systems analysts and developers.

What you will do:
- Lead the implementation of our new cloud ERP general ledger, accounts payable and fixed assets modules.
- Own the roadmap for finance applications: the ERP, the consolidation tool, the planning tool used by FP&A, and expense management.
- Run integrations between the ERP and our manufacturing, procurement and payroll systems.
- Manage system administration, access controls and audit support for finance applications.
- Lead release management, testing and user training during each rollout.
- Manage the systems integrator and software vendors.

What you bring:
- 10+ years in finance systems, ERP implementation or finance technology, with team leadership.
- Hands-on experience implementing a major ERP and a consolidation or planning tool.
- Understanding of accounting processes and controls.
- You will work closely with FP&A and the controller's team, but this role does not own planning, forecasting or reporting.

How we work: we invest in the people who build our products, and we expect leaders to be candid about risk.

This role is hybrid, three days a week at our Chicago office. The base salary range is $165,000 to $185,000, plus bonus.

Stark Industries is an equal opportunity employer.
jobs.rationale:
11,000-person global industrial equipment and power systems manufacturer. Reports to VP Finance Transformation, not a CFO line. Owns ERP implementation, finance app roadmap, vendor management; explicitly no planning, forecasting, or reporting. Culture: people-first, candor on risk expected.
Criteria: team +1. Hybrid near Chicago, IL: +1. Function: outside the target department: capped at 4.

jobs.title: FP&A Director
jobs.description:
Los Pollos Hermanos is a fast-casual restaurant chain with 140 locations across the Southwest, known for fresh chicken, house-made sides and fast service. We are a 4,000-person company, and we are adding twenty restaurants a year.

We are hiring an FP&A Director to lead planning and analysis from our Albuquerque headquarters. You will report to the Chief Financial Officer and lead a team of two analysts.

Responsibilities:
- Own the annual budget and the monthly forecast for the company and each restaurant.
- Build the long-range plan and the new-restaurant investment model.
- Track new-restaurant openings against their investment cases.
- Analyze restaurant-level margins, labor and food costs with operations leaders.
- Support pricing and menu decisions with clear analysis.
- Lead and develop the FP&A team.

Qualifications:
- 8+ years in FP&A, including several in restaurants, retail or another multi-unit business.
- Experience leading one or two analysts.
- Strong command of unit economics and four-wall profitability.
- Comfort working side by side with restaurant operators.

This role is onsite, five days a week at our Albuquerque headquarters. The base salary range is $140,000 to $155,000, plus an annual bonus.

Los Pollos Hermanos is an equal opportunity employer.
jobs.rationale:
4,000-person fast-casual chain, 140 SW locations, rapid expansion. Top FP&A seat, reports to CFO. Owns annual budget, rolling forecast, long-range plan, unit economics, team of two analysts. Culture: no signal in posting.
Criteria: owns plan +3, cfo line +1, team +1, board reporting +1. Relo: elsewhere in US: -5.

jobs.title: Director of FP&A
jobs.description:
Canto Bight Casino Group owns and operates four resort casinos with hotels, restaurants and entertainment venues. We employ about 9,000 people and host more than twelve million guests a year.

We are hiring a Director of FP&A to lead planning for the group. You will report to the Chief Financial Officer and lead a team of eight analysts and managers.

Responsibilities:
- Own the annual budget, the monthly forecast and the five-year plan for the group and each property.
- Analyze gaming, hotel, food and beverage, and entertainment results, and explain what drives them.
- Prepare the monthly management package and the quarterly board presentation.
- Build the investment cases for property renovations and new venues.
- Work with property leaders on labor planning, pricing and cost control.
- Lead and develop the FP&A team.

Qualifications:
- 10+ years in FP&A, including several in hospitality, gaming or another multi-property business.
- Experience leading a team of analysts and managers.
- Strong modeling and presentation skills.
- Ability to obtain the gaming license this role requires.

Our culture: we run around the clock, we reward people who keep their composure under pressure, and we promote from within.

The role is onsite at our Las Vegas headquarters. The base salary range is $160,000 to $190,000, plus an annual bonus.

Canto Bight Casino Group is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Director of FP&A, Retail Banking
jobs.description:
Gringotts is a private bank serving families, businesses and institutions from its headquarters in London. It has kept its customers' assets safe for generations and employs about 3,000 people across the United Kingdom.

We are hiring a Director of FP&A for our retail banking division. You will report to the division's Finance Director and lead a team of six.

Responsibilities:
- Own the annual plan and the quarterly forecast for retail banking.
- Model net interest income, fee income and operating costs under different rate scenarios.
- Prepare the division's monthly performance pack and its input to the group board.
- Work with product and branch leaders on pricing and cost decisions.
- Support capital planning and regulatory submissions with the treasury and risk teams.
- Lead and develop the planning team.

Qualifications:
- 10+ years in FP&A in banking or financial services.
- Experience leading a team and presenting to senior committees.
- Knowledge of UK banking regulation and capital requirements.
- A professional accounting qualification.

How we work: we are careful, we keep our promises, and we expect the same of everyone who works here.

The role is hybrid, three days a week at our London office. Applicants must have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Salary is competitive and includes an annual bonus.

Gringotts is an equal opportunity employer.
jobs.rationale: Outside US: dropped by the location filter before scoring.

jobs.title: Director of Budget and Financial Planning
jobs.location: Mos Eisley, Tatooine (off-planet; hired through the London office)
jobs.description:
The Tatooine Department of Treasury manages the public finances of a remote desert settlement: water rights, trade levies, port fees and the budget of every public service. The department employs about 400 people and reports to the governing council.

We are hiring a Director of Budget and Financial Planning to lead the annual budget and the long-range financial plan. You will report to the Treasurer and lead a team of six budget analysts.

Responsibilities:
- Own the annual budget, from departmental requests through council approval.
- Build the multi-year financial plan, including water infrastructure and port investments.
- Forecast revenue from trade levies and port fees, and explain what moves them.
- Prepare the quarterly financial report to the governing council.
- Work with department heads on spending plans and performance measures.
- Lead and develop the budget team.

Qualifications:
- 10+ years in public budgeting, government finance or FP&A, including team leadership.
- Experience presenting a budget to an elected body.
- Strong forecasting skills and clear writing.
- Willingness to relocate off-planet; the department arranges transport and housing.

How we work: we publish every budget, we answer to the public, and we plan for scarcity.

The role is onsite in Mos Eisley. Hiring is managed through the department's London office. Salary follows the department's published pay scale.

The Tatooine Department of Treasury is an equal opportunity employer.
jobs.rationale: Outside US: dropped by the location filter before scoring.
